description: Implementation of the ControlService class managing control connections, application state, and heartbeat procedures within the Rialto server service.

classes.name: ControlService
classes.description: Manages control connections, application state, and heartbeat procedures for the Rialto server.

methods.name: addControl
methods.description: Creates and registers a new control with a specified ID and client.

methods.name: removeControl
methods.description: Removes the control with the specified ID.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges a control message with a given ID for a specific control.

methods.name: setApplicationState
methods.description: Sets the current application state and propagates it to all controls.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping to all controls using a heartbeat procedure.
